name: N-Phenethylnormorphine
summary: N-Phenethylnormorphine is an opioid analgesic drug derived from morphine by replacing the N-methyl group with β-phenethyl. It is around eight to fourteen times more potent than morphine as a result of this modification, in contrast to most other N-substituted derivatives of morphine, which are substantially less active, or act as antagonists.

pharmacology.text: It is around eight to fourteen times more potent than morphine as a result of this modification, in contrast to most other N-substituted derivatives of morphine, which are substantially less active, or act as antagonists.

uses.en: It is a research compound and has never been approved as a medicine.
uses.zh: 它是研究用化合物，從未被核准作為藥物。
uses.zhHans: 它是研究用化合物，从未被核准作为药物。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the opioids, cause drowsiness, nausea, constipation and slowed breathing, and an overdose can stop breathing altogether. Being stronger than morphine, it would carry a serious risk of overdose and dependence.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。它所屬的鴉片類藥物會造成嗜睡、噁心、便祕與呼吸變慢，過量時可能導致呼吸完全停止。由於比嗎啡更強，它的過量與成癮風險都很嚴重。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。它所属的鸦片类药物会造成嗜睡、恶心、便秘与呼吸变慢，过量时可能导致呼吸完全停止。由于比吗啡更强，它的过量与成瘾风险都很严重。

fact.en: Most changes to the nitrogen of morphine weaken it, and an allyl group even turns it into the blocker nalorphine, but a phenethyl group does the opposite and makes it stronger.
fact.zh: 對嗎啡氮原子的大多數改動都會削弱藥效，換上烯丙基甚至會變成拮抗劑烯丙嗎啡，但換成苯乙基卻恰恰相反，會讓藥效更強。
fact.zhHans: 对吗啡氮原子的大多数改动都会削弱药效，换上烯丙基甚至会变成拮抗剂烯丙吗啡，但换成苯乙基却恰恰相反，会让药效更强。
